about: Get an entry permit for a visit, tourism, treatment, study, a work mission or to complete residence procedures.
note: Requirements read from the official ICP service page on the checked date. ICP fills the form in from the person's records after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Applied for by a sponsor or entity: relative or friend host, tourism firm, healthcare facility, employer or university
Valid UAE health insurance and passport valid for at least 6 months
Host minimum monthly salary: 4,000 AED for first-degree relatives, 8,000 AED for second- and third-degree, 15,000 AED for friends
Enter the UAE within 60 days of issue
Visit stays of 30, 60 or 90 days, extendable up to 120 days in total
documents: Medical report for treatment, visit and work categories
Employer papers and good conduct certificate for work missions
fees: Application fee 100 AED and smart service fee 100 AED
Visit visa issue 100 AED per month single entry, 200 AED per month multiple entry
Financial guarantee 1,000 AED single entry or 2,000 AED multiple entry
channels: ICP Smart Services website or ICP Smart App (sign in with UAE PASS)
